text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Tosen Jordan was walking 
through town with a gloomy expression. And 
that's when Marvelous Sunday spotted her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She announced she was going to take the 
depressed Tosen Jordan to the Marvelous 
Spot.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait! I told you I'm fine! I said it's 
nothing, didn't I~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! The cause of your slump is a lack 
of Mahrvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's embark on an adventure to 
refuel on Marvelous together☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, listen to me, okay!? I just messed up 
my nail polish, that's all~~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Here's the first Marvelous Spot☆ Look, 
there's a marvelous right over there!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
? I mean, there're tons of turtles, sure, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh...? Why are they lined up in 
a spiral? Did someone arrange them like 
this...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know! No matter when I come here, 
they're always making that pattern! See? 
Isn't it totally marvelous☆"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. Well, I guess it might bring a 
little good luck.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Next up: a vending machine where you 
always win a prize☆ Taking a break at a 
relaxing Marvelous Spot★

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Seriously, that's awesome. Gimme one♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Here you go, avocado coffee☆ Now 
then, bottoms up!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? Now that I look closer, this vending 
machine only has weird juice!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Heh, hehe, ahaha... Hahaha! Why the heck 
is it fruity?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! All I can do is laugh at this!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! That's turning into a 
marvelous smile☆ With that said, let's 
head to our special, top-secret Marvelous 
Spot next!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, alright, I get it. Fine. I'll come 
along with you.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: We're here! The Marvelous scenic spot!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... Seriously? No, this is seriously 
incredible... For real. Like... wow...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Touring the Marvelous Spots has had 
an immediate effect★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to lose sight of the marvelous 
over trivial things. But you noticed, 
didn't you? What's right beside you at any 
given time is also marvelous☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Soothing my heart with the mysterious 
marvelousness of the turtles' alignment—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Laughing together over drinks that taste 
bad, smiling together over a fun, 
marvelous time—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And taking in that beautiful scenery 
filled me with so much wonder and awe that 
BAM—Marvelous discovery☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...What, so you really were thinking 
about it. 'Marvelous', huh. Sounds pretty 
nice."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~! I knew you'd say that, Jordan! In 
that case, I'll show you the ultimate 
marvelous for the grand finale!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's up? Is there another amazing 
Marvelous spot?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Now, try closing your eyes—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Try tasting the marvelousness firsthand☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah!? W-Wait, huh, what... I-I-Is this 
really...?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
How is it? Feeling the ultra-mystical 
Marvelous directly with your bare spirit?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because it doesn't pass through the filter 
of a physical body, you can feel 100% pure 
Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now, accept the Marvelous just as you are. 
Marvelous, Marvelous, Marvelous...☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
H-Haha... So this is... 
Marvelous............

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Ahaha☆ How was it? Marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I was sweating the small stuff way too 
much.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Marvelous-chan. I feel kinda 
motivated now!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Jordan's feeling all better, and 
that's suuuper marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday was genuinely overjoyed 
to see Tosen Jordan make such a splendid 
comeback.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The Earth really was blue, for real...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Imma LANE Helios about what just 
happened. "Went to outer space. Marvelous 
was insane."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Unreal! Marvelous is so unreeeeal☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
With a squeaky-clean, sparkling brain, 
that's a full 100-point Marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My body feels so light... wait, actually, 
my feet kinda feel all floaty...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's because you left your physical body 
for a bit. It's proof that you properly 
experienced the Marvelous!☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, it's pretty fun, so I guess 
this is Marvelous too?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's marvelous too☆ If you ever 
want to learn more, just let me know 
anytime!
